process.commandLine: bash -c 'set -u; echo SANDBOX_NETNS=$(readlink /proc/self/ns/net); capeff=$(grep "^CapEff" /proc/self/status | cut -f2); if [ -z "$capeff" ]; then echo NO_CAPEFF; exit 1; fi; if [ $((0x$capeff & 0x1000)) -ne 0 ]; then echo CAP_NET_ADMIN_RETAINED; exit 1; fi; echo CAP_NET_ADMIN_DROPPED_OK; echo V6_ICMP_RULES_INSTALLED_OK'
